grades.quote: To ensure that certain implicit reads are ordered only after writes to the same memory locations, software must execute specific fence or cache-control instructions defined for this purpose (such as the FENCE.I instruction defined in Chapter 5).
grades.reason: Only mentions FENCE.I in passing as the kind of instruction software must execute to order implicit instruction-fetch reads after writes. It never says whether FENCE.I affects only the local hart or all harts, so it gives limited background and no direct answer.
Covers reserved fields and the relaxed memory model for the FENCE (memory ordering) instruction. It says nothing about FENCE.I, instruction-fetch synchronization, or other harts.
